Downtown & Old Town.name: Downtown & Old Town
Downtown & Old Town.description: Central business district and Old Town loft corridor with office conversions, heritage adaptive reuse, and high-density residential demand.

Delano.name: Delano
Delano.description: West-side riverfront district along Douglas Avenue with boutique hospitality, mixed-use infill, and entertainment-driven reinvestment.

College Hill.name: College Hill
College Hill.description: East-side historic residential corridor with restored early-century housing and steady owner-occupant renovation activity.

Riverside.name: Riverside
Riverside.description: Northwest riverfront and park-adjacent neighborhood with historic homes, civic investment, and enclave infill activity.

Crown Heights & Midtown.name: Crown Heights & Midtown
Crown Heights & Midtown.description: North-central residential district targeted by reinvestment programs with rehabilitation and infill housing momentum.
